opis.hr: API ključ Anthropica za izravne pozive modela iz daemona (davatelj anthropic u models/model-config.json). Agenti preko Claude CLI-ja ga NE trebaju — oni koriste prijavu CLI-ja ili CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN paketa.
opis.en: Anthropic API key for direct model calls from the daemon (provider anthropic in models/model-config.json). Agents run through the Claude CLI do NOT need it — they use the CLI login or the package's CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.

bez_nje.hr: izravni API pozivi Anthropica (klasifikator, sažeci u procesu daemona) padaju na sljedećeg davatelja ili se preskaču; agenti preko CLI-ja rade normalno.
bez_nje.en: direct Anthropic API calls (classifier, in-process summaries) fall back to the next provider or are skipped; agents via the CLI keep working.

opis.hr: API ključ Google AI Studija. Koriste ga davatelj google (izravni pozivi) i geminicli (agenti kroz `gemini` CLI — daemon ga predaje procesu agenta).

opis.hr: Lozinka PostgreSQL/pgvector baze za RAG kompleta kad je u memory-config.json `rag.backend` = pgvector ili dual (ili REGOC_RAG_BACKEND). Lokalni pgvector paketa (install.sh --baze) ima svoju lozinku TM_PGVECTOR_PASSWORD — ova je samo za vanjsku pgvector bazu.
opis.en: PostgreSQL/pgvector password for the kit's RAG when memory-config.json sets `rag.backend` to pgvector or dual (or REGOC_RAG_BACKEND). The package's local pgvector (install.sh --baze) has its own password TM_PGVECTOR_PASSWORD — this one is only for an external pgvector database.

bez_nje.hr: RAG kompleta na pgvectoru ne radi (pretraga i upis znanja agenata); s ChromaDB-om (zadano) ne treba.
bez_nje.en: the kit's RAG on pgvector does not work (agent knowledge search and store); not needed with ChromaDB (default).
